name: call_free_mem
description: Calls the FreeMem routine through the library base kept in the data area, with no other work.

name: setup_pointer_chain
description: Initializes a four-long list header: its first long points four bytes past the header start, its second long is cleared, and its third long points back at the header.

name: setup_task_and_dispatch
description: Finds the current task through the library, installs its message handlers, runs four setup helpers, and finishes with a library call on the result.

name: return_without_action
description: A bare return with no work and no calls.

name: record_stage_and_dispatch
description: Saves its argument in a stack slot and records a sequence of stage codes in a status word while invoking handler routines from a table; two more handlers are invoked conditionally. It returns the saved argument.

name: scan_hunks_to_end_marker
description: Opens a file through the library and allocates a buffer, then reads 32-bit words and skips each block until the hunk end code is found, counting blocks as it goes. It then closes and frees what it opened and returns the result.

name: clear_flags_and_invoke
description: Clears a pending flag, then for each of two saved library handles that is nonzero calls a library routine through the library base and clears that handle.

name: open_libraries_conditionally
description: Opens a library through the exec library and, if that fails, returns a fallback value. Otherwise it opens a second library and returns its handle, or a fallback value when that also fails.

name: close_libraries_conditionally
description: Closes the first stored library handle through the exec library and clears it when a guard flag allows. As recovered, the second handle is never closed because the guard is set by the first close.

name: dispatch_hunk_record_by_type
description: Handles one AmigaDOS hunk record according to its type code: code and data hunks read their payload, BSS reads its size, 32-bit relocation records patch offsets in referenced hunks, and debug or symbol blocks are skipped.

name: clear_bytes_until_sentinel
description: Loops reading a value from a helper until it returns negative one; on each pass it clears one byte at a computed address and calls the library open routine.

name: allocate_memory_entry_list
description: Allocates a list block through the exec library, fills its header byte and count word, then writes one entry per count with a memory-type flag taken from the high bits of each value and a size. It returns the block, or a fixed fallback value if the allocation result is negative.

name: compute_entry_range
description: Calls a helper three times, storing the results in data slots, then stores their range, the third result minus the second plus one, in a fourth slot.

name: reduce_table_entries_modulo_seed
description: Walks a table of 32-bit entries, replacing each nonzero entry with a bit-serial reduction of the entry plus a seed value, then returns the helper result or an all-ones sentinel when a register value does not match it.

name: repeat_helper_until_zero
description: Calls a helper repeatedly, decrementing the count argument on each pass, until the count reaches zero.

name: return_global_flag_after_call
description: Calls a helper routine, then returns the current value of a global flag.

name: invoke_library_function_conditionally
description: Checks an input register and, if it is nonzero, calls a library function through a stored pointer before returning.

name: run_four_pass_bit_update
description: Runs four passes, storing the pass index in a global and calling helpers on each pass; on the first pass it also toggles a bit in a byte block selected by the bit index. It finishes by resetting the index.

name: call_two_helpers_then_exit
description: Calls two helpers and returns, because its guard flag is a constant zero in the recovered code, so the iteration never repeats.

name: wait_for_flag_value_range
description: Repeatedly calls a helper until the low seven bits of its result are nonzero and at most seventy-nine.

name: call_alloc_mem_or_default
description: Calls the AllocMem wrapper and returns its result, substituting a default size of 65536 when the result is zero.

name: allocate_memory_or_default_size
description: Calls the AllocMem wrapper through a stored pointer and returns its result, substituting a default size of 65536 when the result is zero.

name: free_memory_block_if_set
description: Calls the FreeMem routine through a stored pointer only when the low 30 bits of the size argument and the address argument are both nonzero.

name: free_memory_if_both_set
description: Calls the FreeMem routine through a stored pointer when both the size argument and the address argument are nonzero.

name: compute_crc16_checksum
description: Computes a 16-bit CRC-style checksum over a byte buffer of a given length, shifting bit by bit with a feedback constant, and returns the checksum combined with the input value.

name: increment_counter_and_return
description: When the stored counter is zero it first calls a library routine. It then calls a helper with a fixed seed constant, stores the result plus one as the running counter, and returns the new counter value.

name: compute_fixed_point_product
description: Multiplies two signed values by taking their absolute values, forming 16-bit partial products including the cross terms, and negating the 32-bit result when the signs differ.

name: wait_for_flag_match
description: Stores a constant in a global, then runs up to four iterations calling helpers; once a flag is set it compares two helper values. It returns zero on the first mismatch and all ones if the loop ends without one.

name: call_helper_once_then_return
description: Calls a helper once and returns, because its loop guard is a constant false in the recovered code.

name: rotate_bits_with_condition
description: Reads a word from a helper and, when the guard flag is set, applies eight rounds of bit rotation and masking to it, returning the resulting word.

name: wait_for_marker_value
description: Repeatedly reads helper values until a fixed marker word appears, using a flag and a counter for control, then returns without further action.

name: loop_until_byte_match
description: Loops calling a helper and comparing its returned byte with a target value, advancing a counter by a fixed step on each pass, and exits when the counter wraps to zero or a match is found.

name: combine_alternating_bit_pairs
description: Reads pairs of 32-bit values from a helper, interleaves their bits under an alternating-bit mask, and returns the assembled value once the top byte of the result is all ones. It returns early if a flag clears.

name: call_helper_if_zero_result
description: Calls a helper and, when a guard flag is set and its 32-bit result is zero, calls a second helper; otherwise it returns.

name: read_bitfield_to_word
description: Checks a bit position against a stored limit and returns a constant when it lies beyond the limit; otherwise it reads sixteen bits from a bit table starting at that position and returns them as a word.

name: open_resource_and_wait
description: Opens the disk resource through the exec library, allocates a request block with its fields filled in, and then waits in a loop calling library routines until a nonzero result is returned.

name: invoke_cleanup_sequence
description: Calls a helper, conditionally calls a library routine through the library base, calls another library routine with an argument, then calls two more helpers and a final library routine. It is the cleanup step that releases a signal bit.

name: allocate_signal_message_record
description: Allocates a signal bit through the exec library and, if one is available, allocates a block and fills in its port fields, including a pointer to a global area and the current task reference.

name: configure_disk_dma_transfer
description: Programs the disk controller: sets the disk pointer, the sync word and its enable in the ADKCON word, enables disk DMA, clears the disk block interrupt request, and starts the transfer by writing the length register.

name: start_disk_write_transfer
description: Waits while a status bit is set, then programs the disk pointer, sync word, DMA enable and interrupt request clear, and starts a disk transfer in write mode by writing the length register.

name: check_flag_and_set_values
description: Polls a flag bit in a structure field for up to 400000 iterations; when the bit is set it stores two fixed values and returns zero, otherwise it returns all ones.

name: call_three_helpers
description: Calls three helper routines in sequence and returns.

name: mask_bit_from_port_value
description: Stores the input byte with one bit cleared, the bit chosen by a stored index offset by three, into a global that stands in for a CIA port register.

name: wait_for_cia_status_clear
description: Polls a global mirroring the CIA-A port register for up to 50000 iterations, returning zero as soon as its status bit clears, or the remaining count if it never clears.

name: adjust_table_entry_to_match
description: Calls helpers, then steps a counter up or down one unit at a time until it equals a masked value read from a helper, and stores the matched value in a table slot indexed by a global.

name: return_without_action
description: A bare return with no work and no calls.

name: poll_port_then_clear_slot
description: Polls a global mirroring a CIA-A port bit, calling a helper on each pass while the bit is set. When the bit clears it zeroes a table slot indexed by a global and returns the register value.

name: select_bit_and_delay
description: Updates a port-mirror global by setting its low bits and clearing one selected bit, then runs a short busy loop of about 3000 iterations.

name: select_bit_and_delay_alt
description: Performs the same port-bit update and busy delay as its neighbour, writing a different low-bit pattern to the port mirror.

name: update_port_bit_and_delay
description: Clears the selected bit in the port-mirror global, applies the optional bit clear, then runs a busy delay of about 1500 iterations.

name: busy_wait_count
description: Counts the value passed in a data register down to zero as a busy delay.

name: copy_routine_into_allocated_block
description: Checks an index against a stored bound and traps when it is out of range, stores a value, then allocates memory through the AllocMem wrapper. If the allocation succeeds it copies 352 bytes of routine code into the block.

name: allocate_and_copy_routine_block
description: Allocates a block through the AllocMem wrapper and, if the allocation succeeds, copies 352 bytes of routine code into it, recording the block address in a global. It returns zero.

name: write_instruction_words_to_stack
description: Writes two fixed instruction words into a buffer relative to the stack, then copies one global into another.

name: return_minus_one
description: Returns negative one with no other work.

key: abandoned places 2 (1993)(ice)(de-en)(disk 1 of 5)[cr pdx]/Abandoned Places 2 (1993)(ICE)(De-En)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr PDX].adf:bootblock:0:000C
name: boot_clear_colors_and_relocate
description: Boot-block entry that waits on blitter and DMA status, clears the 32 colour registers, copies a block of code into low memory, and jumps to it.

key: abandoned places 2 (1993)(ice)(de-en)(disk 1 of 5)[cr pdx]/Abandoned Places 2 (1993)(ICE)(De-En)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr PDX].adf:bootblock:0:001A
name: copy_code_low_and_jump
description: Waits for DMA and interrupt activity to settle, disables all interrupts and DMA channels by writing clear masks, clears the 32 colour registers, copies a block of code into low memory, and jumps to it.

key: abandoned places 2 (1993)(ice)(de-en)(disk 1 of 5)[cr pdx]/Abandoned Places 2 (1993)(ICE)(De-En)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr PDX].adf:bootblock:0:0066
name: verify_signature_and_launch
description: Repeatedly issues disk-controller commands through a memory-mapped port and polls for completion, retrying until a four-byte signature in the loaded block matches and the status value reaches two, then jumps through a stored pointer.

key: abandoned places 2 (1993)(ice)(de-en)(disk 1 of 5)[cr pdx]/Abandoned Places 2 (1993)(ICE)(De-En)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr PDX].adf:bootblock:0:00AC
name: wait_status_two_then_call
description: Repeatedly calls a helper until it returns zero and its status value is two, then calls a stored routine pointer.

key: abandoned places 2 (1993)(ice)(de-en)(disk 1 of 5)[cr pdx]/Abandoned Places 2 (1993)(ICE)(De-En)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr PDX].adf:bootblock:0:00C6
name: start_mfm_read_and_poll
description: Configures the disk controller for an MFM read with a standard sync word, starts a read of a fixed block length, and polls until a completion flag appears or a helper reports done.

key: abandoned places 2 (1993)(ice)(de-en)(disk 1 of 5)[cr pdx]/Abandoned Places 2 (1993)(ICE)(De-En)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr PDX].adf:bootblock:0:0116
name: call_helper_then_return
description: Calls a helper routine and returns with no other work.

key: abandoned places 2 (1993)(ice)(de-en)(disk 1 of 5)[cr pdx]/Abandoned Places 2 (1993)(ICE)(De-En)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr PDX].adf:bootblock:0:011E
name: stop_disk_dma_return_error
description: Clears the disk length register to stop disk DMA, then returns a negative-one status.

key: abandoned places 2 (1993)(ice)(de-en)(disk 1 of 5)[cr pdx]/Abandoned Places 2 (1993)(ICE)(De-En)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr PDX].adf:bootblock:0:012E
name: step_disk_head_to_track
description: Sets the side select bit from the low bit of the requested cylinder, then steps the drive head one track toward the target. If the current position is unknown it first steps toward track zero until the track-zero sensor responds, and it finishes with a short delay.

key: abandoned places 2 (1993)(ice)(de-en)(disk 1 of 5)[cr pdx]/Abandoned Places 2 (1993)(ICE)(De-En)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr PDX].adf:bootblock:0:013E
name: step_disk_head_side_zero
description: Forces the side select bit, then performs the same recalibration and one-track step toward the target position as its neighbour.

key: abandoned places 2 (1993)(ice)(de-en)(disk 1 of 5)[cr pdx]/Abandoned Places 2 (1993)(ICE)(De-En)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr PDX].adf:bootblock:0:015A
name: step_disk_head_toward_target
description: Resets the head position word to zero, steps one track toward the target held in an argument, then waits a fixed delay.

key: abandoned places 2 (1993)(ice)(de-en)(disk 1 of 5)[cr pdx]/Abandoned Places 2 (1993)(ICE)(De-En)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr PDX].adf:bootblock:0:016C
name: step_head_outward_one_track
description: Decrements the head position word, sets the step-direction bits in the drive port mirror, and waits a short delay.

key: abandoned places 2 (1993)(ice)(de-en)(disk 1 of 5)[cr pdx]/Abandoned Places 2 (1993)(ICE)(De-En)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr PDX].adf:bootblock:0:0182
name: poll_hardware_byte_delay
description: Performs a fixed number of hardware polls, each waiting for a memory-mapped byte to change, then returns the input registers unchanged.

key: abandoned places 2 (1993)(ice)(de-en)(disk 1 of 5)[cr pdx]/Abandoned Places 2 (1993)(ICE)(De-En)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr PDX].adf:bootblock:0:019E
name: clear_port_latch_bit
description: Writes a control byte to a port latch, clears the bit chosen by the argument offset by three, and returns the argument unchanged.

key: abandoned places 2 (1993)(ice)(de-en)(disk 1 of 5)[cr pdx]/Abandoned Places 2 (1993)(ICE)(De-En)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr PDX].adf:bootblock:0:01B8
name: write_port_control_sequence
description: Writes a fixed three-byte control sequence to a port latch: all bits set, a specific pattern, then all bits set again.

key: abandoned places 2 (1993)(ice)(de-en)(disk 1 of 5)[cr pdx]/Abandoned Places 2 (1993)(ICE)(De-En)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr PDX].adf:bootblock:0:01CE
name: decode_mfm_sector_track
description: Scans a raw MFM track buffer for sync words, checks each sector header's track number and format, decodes its odd and even bits, verifies its checksum, and copies the decoded sector to the destination. It records each good sector in a bitmap and returns a status code for the first failure.

key: abandoned places 2 (1993)(ice)(de-en)(disk 1 of 5)[cr pdx]/Abandoned Places 2 (1993)(ICE)(De-En)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr PDX].adf:bootblock:0:0206
name: decode_mfm_sectors_until_end
description: Decodes consecutive MFM sectors from a raw track by locating each sync word, decoding odd and even bits, and verifying checksums. It marks decoded sectors in a bitmap until the length budget runs out or the bitmap is full.

key: abandoned places 2 (1993)(ice)(de-en)(disk 1 of 5)[cr pdx]/Abandoned Places 2 (1993)(ICE)(De-En)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr PDX].adf:bootblock:0:0212
name: decode_mfm_sector_pairs
description: Decodes MFM sector data from a raw track in a loop, checking the header value, decoding odd and even bits and verifying the checksum. It returns a status code on the first error or when the length budget runs out.

key: abandoned places 2 (1993)(ice)(de-en)(disk 1 of 5)[cr pdx]/Abandoned Places 2 (1993)(ICE)(De-En)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr PDX].adf:bootblock:0:027E
name: return_status_one
description: Returns status code one in the high half of its result with no other work.

key: abandoned places 2 (1993)(ice)(de-en)(disk 1 of 5)[cr pdx]/Abandoned Places 2 (1993)(ICE)(De-En)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr PDX].adf:bootblock:0:0282
name: return_status_two
description: Returns status code two in the high half of its result with no other work.

key: abandoned places 2 (1993)(ice)(de-en)(disk 1 of 5)[cr pdx]/Abandoned Places 2 (1993)(ICE)(De-En)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr PDX].adf:bootblock:0:0286
name: return_status_three
description: Returns status code three in the high half of its result with no other work.

key: abandoned places 2 (1993)(ice)(de-en)(disk 1 of 5)[cr pdx]/Abandoned Places 2 (1993)(ICE)(De-En)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr PDX].adf:bootblock:0:028A
name: return_status_four
description: Returns status code four in the high half of its result with no other work.

key: abandoned places 2 (1993)(ice)(de-en)(disk 1 of 5)[cr pdx]/Abandoned Places 2 (1993)(ICE)(De-En)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr PDX].adf:bootblock:0:028E
name: return_status_five
description: Returns status code five in the high half of its result with no other work.

key: abandoned places 2 (1993)(ice)(de-en)(disk 1 of 5)[cr pdx]/Abandoned Places 2 (1993)(ICE)(De-En)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr PDX].adf:bootblock:0:0292
name: return_argument_unchanged
description: Returns its stack argument unchanged.

key: abandoned places 2 (1993)(ice)(de-en)(disk 1 of 5)[cr pdx]/Abandoned Places 2 (1993)(ICE)(De-En)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr PDX].adf:bootblock:0:029E
name: read_blocks_and_call_loaded
description: Reads a block from disk through the exec library's DoIO call into a buffer, calls the routine loaded there, copies a small code stub into low memory, then reads a second block from the start of the disk into the program start.

key: abandoned places 2 (1993)(ice)(de-en)(disk 1 of 5)[cr pdx]/Abandoned Places 2 (1993)(ICE)(De-En)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr PDX].adf:bootblock:0:02CA
name: read_blocks_and_call_loaded
description: Performs the same two disk reads through the exec library's DoIO call as its neighbour, calling the loaded routine between them and copying a small code stub into low memory.

key: abandoned places 2 (1993)(ice)(de-en)(disk 1 of 5)[cr pdx]/Abandoned Places 2 (1993)(ICE)(De-En)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr PDX].adf:bootblock:0:0322
name: patch_jump_and_call_base
description: Writes a jump-to-subroutine instruction with a fixed short target into a patch slot, then calls the routine pointer stored in the argument block.
